normal.cn: projectile 共享「扔」的词根，例如投石器抛出的石子。

normal.en: Compare screen: the projector throws the image, the screen receives it.
normal.cn: 对比 screen：投影仪抛出图像，屏幕接收图像。

abstract.en: Picture a dark room where a beam of light suddenly strikes the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一间黑屋子，忽然有一束光打在墙上。

abstract.en: Think of a child throwing a paper plane forward across the room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子把纸飞机往前扔过房间。

abstract.en: Imagine a lamp shining out of a box towards a white screen.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯从盒子里向外照，照到一块白幕上。

examples.en: The projector in the meeting room stopped working halfway through the talk.
examples.cn: 会议室里的投影仪讲到一半就坏了。

examples.en: Teachers often borrow a projector for film lessons.
examples.cn: 老师上电影课时常借投影仪。

examples.en: Please clean the projector lens before the presentation.
examples.cn: 演示前请把投影镜头擦干净。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑 若 杰 克 特」——把光像扑克牌一样「扑」到墙上，「特」别清楚地显示出来；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ iacere（扔）→ proicere（向前抛）→ projectus → 英语 project，再加后缀 -or 得 projector，核心义「向前抛出光或图像的东西」。

sensesIntro.en: Projector begins with the device that throws an image forward, widens to planning and thrusting objects, and ends with architecture and psychology.
sensesIntro.cn: projector 首先指把图像向前投出的设备，再扩展到规划者与喷射装置，最后进入建筑与心理学的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a beam of light leaping from a lens to the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束光从镜头跳到墙上。

branches.en: The image machine is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 影像设备是现代的主要义项。

branches.en: The planner is the older person sense.
branches.cn: 规划者是较早出现的人称义项。

branches.en: A device that thrusts something out is the technical sense.
branches.cn: 向外推射的装置是技术义项。

branches.en: Architecture throws parts outward, psychology throws feelings onto others.
branches.cn: 建筑把构件往外抛，心理学把情感往外投。

branches.en: Both the machine and the planner send something ahead of them.
branches.cn: 机器与规划者都把某种东西送到前面去。

intro.en: Projector is built on the Latin throw root, with English project, projection, and projectile around it.
intro.cn: projector 建立在拉丁语「扔」的词根上，周围有英语的 project、projection 与 projectile。

latinIntro.en: Iacere means to throw, pro- means forward, and projector means one who throws forth.
latinIntro.cn: iacere 意为扔，pro- 意为向前，projector 意为向前抛出的人。

items.example: The prefix pro- sets the direction forward.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 pro- 定下向前的方向。

items.example: Iacere gives the throw image.
items.exampleCN: iacere 提供「抛」的意象。

items.example: Proicere is the source verb.
items.exampleCN: proicere 是来源动词。

items.example: Projectus links the verb to the noun.
items.exampleCN: projectus 把动词与名词连起来。

items.example: Projector keeps the Latin agent noun.
items.exampleCN: projector 保留了拉丁语施事名词。

items.meaning: a person or thing that does
items.meaningCN: 表示「做事的人或物」的后缀
items.example: The suffix -or marks the agent.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -or 表示施事者。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ion forms projection.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 构成 projection。

items.meaningCN: 表示与某动作相关之物的后缀
items.example: The suffix -ile forms projectile.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ile 构成 projectile。

items.example: The suffix -able forms projectable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 projectable。

definition_zh: 多产的；丰产的；多育的；（艺术家、作家）作品众多的；高产的
definition_en: producing a large number of young, fruits, works, or results
core_image: 一根藤上挂满果实，果枝被压得低垂
scene: 果园里有一棵老苹果树，结出的果子多到枝条都垂到地面。The old apple tree was remarkably prolific, bearing so much fruit that its branches bent to the ground.
sceneCN: 这里 prolific 是「多产的、丰产的」（第 1 个义项：动植物大量结果或繁殖）；句意：那棵老苹果树非常丰产，结的果子多到枝头垂到地面。

pos.zh: 多产的；丰产的；多育的；作品众多的；高产的

derivatives.zh: prolific 加词尾 -ally 构成，义为「多产地；丰产地」
prolific 加 -ness 构成，义为「多产的性质」
与 prolific 同源于拉丁语 proles（后代）与 -fer，义为「激增；繁殖」
proliferate 加 -ion 构成，义为「激增；增殖」
口语缩写，主张保护胎儿的生命的，与 prolific 只是拼写相近，词源不同

senses.title: Fruitful in bearing young or fruit
senses.definition: bearing a large number of offspring, seeds, or fruits
senses.definitionCN: 产生大量后代、种子或果实的
senses.example: Rabbits are prolific breeders and can double their numbers in a season.
senses.exampleCN: 兔子繁殖力极强，一个季节里数量就能翻倍。
senses.why: The Latin root proles means offspring, and ferre means to bring, so the core sense is bringing forth plenty.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 proles 意为「后代」，ferre 意为「带来」，所以这个词的核心画面就是不断带来大量后代或果实。

senses.title: Producing many works or ideas
senses.definition: producing a great number of books, songs, ideas, or other creative works
senses.definitionCN: 写出、创作出大量书籍、歌曲或想法的
senses.example: She is one of the most prolific novelists of her generation.
senses.exampleCN: 她是她那一代最多产的小说家之一。
senses.why: The same fruit-bearing image moves from plants to the mind: a writer whose output hangs heavy like fruit on a branch.
senses.whyCN: 同一个结果子的画面从植物挪到头脑：作家的作品像挂满的果实一样压弯枝条。

senses.title: Bearing many young over time
senses.definition: having many children, especially when applied figuratively to a family
senses.definitionCN: 有许多子女的，常用于比喻一个家族
senses.example: The couple came from a prolific family of nine children.
senses.exampleCN: 这对夫妻出身于一个有九个孩子的多子女家庭。
senses.why: The offspring sense stays literal when the subject is a family that keeps adding members.
senses.whyCN: 当主语是一个不断添丁的家庭时，「后代」这一义素保持字面意义。

intro.en: Prolific comes from medieval Latin prolificus, made of proles, offspring, and the root of facere, to make.
intro.cn: prolific 来自中世纪拉丁语 prolificus，由 proles（后代）与 facere（做、产生）的词根组合而成。

items.en: Proles means offspring or descendants.
items.cn: proles 意为后代、子孙。

items.en: The one who brings forth is proles plus facere, to make.
items.cn: 产生后代的说法由 proles 与 facere（做）组合而成。

items.en: Prolificus names something that bears young in abundance.
items.cn: prolificus 指大量生育后代的事物。

items.en: Prolific enters English first of plants and animals.
items.cn: prolific 在十七世纪进入英语，最初用于植物和动物。

items.en: Modern usage extends the word to writers, athletes, and ideas.
items.cn: 现代用法把这个词扩展到作家、运动员和思想。

note.en: Prolific belongs to the family of fruitful words, and it looks like other pro-starting Latin terms.
note.cn: prolific 属于「多产」这一语义家族，外形上又与若干以 pro 开头的拉丁词相近。

entries.definition: the quality of being prolific
to increase greatly in number
too long and wordy
entries.definitionCN: 冗长拖沓的；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: able to produce abundant growth
yielding useful results or output
existing in large quantities

normalIntro.en: Picture proles as offspring plus ferre as bringing, so prolific means bringing forth plenty.
normalIntro.cn: 把 proles 想成「后代」，把 ferre 想成「带来」，prolific 就是「不断带来大量」的意思。

normal.en: A prolific writer publishes several books a year.
normal.cn: 多产作家一年能出版好几本书。

normal.en: Prolific comes from proles, offspring, the same root as proliferate.
normal.cn: prolific 来自 proles（后代），与 proliferate 同根。

normal.en: Rabbits are famous for being prolific breeders.
normal.cn: 兔子以繁殖力强而闻名。

normal.en: A prolific scorer averages several goals every season.
normal.cn: 高产射手每个赛季平均进好几个球。

normal.en: Compare productive: productive stresses useful results, prolific stresses sheer quantity.
normal.cn: 对比 productive：productive 强调有用的成果，prolific 强调数量之多。

abstract.en: See a vine so loaded with fruit that it bends.
abstract.cn: 想象一根藤挂满果实，被压得弯曲。

abstract.en: Imagine a shelf of books that keeps growing every month.
abstract.cn: 想象一排书架每个月都在变长。

abstract.en: Think of a rabbit hole full of small rabbits.
abstract.cn: 想象一个兔子洞里挤满小兔子。

examples.en: The region has soil so rich that local farmers are unusually prolific.
examples.cn: 这个地区的土壤如此肥沃，当地农夫格外多产。

examples.en: He was a prolific composer who wrote over six hundred works.
examples.cn: 他是一位多产作曲家，创作了六百多部作品。

examples.en: Prolific species spread quickly into newly opened habitats.
examples.cn: 多产物种能迅速扩散到新开放的栖息地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑得离谱」——果子多到扑出来、多得离谱，就是多产；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 proles（后代）＋ facere（做、产生）→ 中世纪拉丁语 prolificus（多育的）→ 英语 prolific，核心义「不断带来大量」。

sensesIntro.en: Prolific starts with plants and animals that yield a great deal, then moves to creators who produce many works, and finally to families with many children.
sensesIntro.cn: prolific 先指动植物大量结果或繁殖，再指创作者产出大量作品，最后指子女众多的家庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vine so heavy with fruit that its branches bend.
core.cn: 核心意象：挂满果实、枝条被压弯的藤。

branches.en: The literal botanical and zoological sense is the oldest.
branches.cn: 植物与动物的字面多育义是最早的义项。

branches.en: Creative output is the modern dominant sense.
branches.cn: 创作产量是现代最主流的义项。

branches.en: The family sense keeps offspring literal.
branches.cn: 家庭义项保留了「后代」的字面意思。

branches.en: Both describe bodies that keep adding new lives.
branches.cn: 两者都描述不断增添新生命的身体。

branches.en: Fruit and books are both harvests that hang from the same image.
branches.cn: 果实与书籍都是同一画面上的收成。

intro.en: Prolific is built from the Latin noun proles and a form of facere, with an adjective ending.
intro.cn: prolific 由拉丁名词 proles 与 facere 的词形组合，再加形容词词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin proles means offspring, and the -fic element comes from facere, to make or do.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 proles 意为后代，其中的 fic 部分来自 facere（做、产生）。

items.example: Proles supplies the offspring image.
items.exampleCN: proles 提供「后代」的意象。

items.example: Facere gives the bringing forth idea.
items.exampleCN: facere 给出「产生」的意思。

items.example: The -fic element forms prolific and scientific.
items.exampleCN: fic 这一成分构成 prolific 与 scientific。

items.example: The suffix -ic forms the adjective prolific.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 ic 构成形容词 prolific。

items.example: Proliferate adds the offspring root to a verb of increase.
items.exampleCN: proliferate 把「后代」词根加在表示增长的意义上。

items.example: Proliferation names the growth itself.
items.exampleCN: proliferation 指增长这件事。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms prolificness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 ness 构成 prolificness。

items.example: The adverb prolifically ends in -ally.
items.exampleCN: 副词 prolifically 以 ally 结尾。

definition_zh: 可发音的；读得出来的；容易念的；适合说出口的
definition_en: able to be pronounced, or easy to say clearly
core_image: 一张张开的嘴，字音顺利滑出口
scene: 老师把一串生僻字母写在黑板上，学生试着念了念，发现这串字母其实能念出来。The teacher wrote a long unfamiliar word on the board, and the students found that it was surprisingly pronounceable.
sceneCN: 这里 pronounceable 是「可发音的、读得出来的」（第 1 个义项：能够被念出声）；句意：老师写了一个很长的生词在黑板上，学生们发现这个词竟出人意料地好念。

pos.zh: 可发音的；读得出来的；容易念的

derivatives.zh: pronounceable 的基础动词，义为「发音；宣布」
由 pronounce 变形加 -ation 构成，义为「发音；读音」
pronounce 加 -ment 构成，义为「声明；公告」
pronounceable 加否定前缀 un- 构成，义为「无法发音的」
pronounce 的过去分词作形容词，义为「明显的；显著的」

senses.title: Able to be spoken aloud
senses.definition: capable of being articulated with the sounds of a language
senses.definitionCN: 能够用某种语言的语音发出来的
senses.example: The name is long but clearly pronounceable.
senses.exampleCN: 这个名字虽长，但明显念得出来。
senses.why: The suffix able adds the idea of possibility to the verb pronounce, so the word simply says that speaking it aloud is possible.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 able 给动词 pronounce 加上「可以」的意思，所以这个词只是说「把它念出来是可能的」。

senses.title: Easy to say
senses.definition: smooth and simple for a speaker of the language to say without effort
senses.definitionCN: 对说这种语言的人来说念起来顺畅通顺、不费力的
senses.example: Marketers prefer short pronounceable brand names.
senses.exampleCN: 营销人员偏爱简短、顺口的品牌名。
senses.why: From mere possibility the word often slides into ease, because what can be said is usually what says itself easily.
senses.whyCN: 词义常常从「能够」滑向「容易」，因为念得出来的往往也就是顺口好念的。

senses.title: Suitable to declare openly
senses.definition: suitable for being stated in public, used of words or judgments
senses.definitionCN: 适合当众说出或宣读的，用于形容言辞或判断
senses.example: The findings are not yet pronounceable in public.
senses.exampleCN: 这些研究结果目前还不适合公开宣布。
senses.why: The formal sense of pronounce as declare is drawn into the adjective: what is pronounceable in public is what may be said aloud.
senses.whyCN: pronounce 的正式义「宣布」被带进了形容词：可以在公开场合 pronounce 的，就是能够当众说出的话。

intro.en: Pronounceable is the English adjective of pronounce, which goes back through Old French and Latin to pro- plus nuntiare.
intro.cn: pronounceable 是 pronounce 的英语形容词，而 pronounce 经古法语可追溯到拉丁语 pro- 加 nuntiare。

items.en: Nuntiare means to announce, and pronuntiare means to proclaim.
items.cn: nuntiare 意为宣告，pronuntiare 意为宣布。

items.en: Pronuntiare also covers the act of uttering sounds in speech.
items.cn: pronuntiare 也涵盖说出语音这一行为。

items.en: The French verb prononcier carries the word into French.
items.cn: 法语动词 prononcier 把这个词带入法语。

items.en: English takes pronounce with the sense of speaking and declaring.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 pronounce，表示说出与宣布。

items.en: The suffix -able forms pronounceable, meaning able to be spoken.
items.cn: 词尾 -able 构成 pronounceable，表示能被说出口。

note.en: Pronounceable is a -able adjective of the send-and-announce family, close to speech verbs and to its own base.
note.cn: pronounceable 属于「说出、宣告」家族中的 able 形容词，与言语类动词及其基词都很近。

entries.definition: to say a word in the correct way
the way a word is said
impossible to say aloud
clear enough to be read
spoken clearly and distinctly
entries.definitionCN: 表达清楚的；口齿清晰的

entries.definition: pleasant to hear

normalIntro.en: Take pronounce, add able, and you get able to be pronounced; the mouth can carry it through.
normalIntro.cn: 把 pronounce 加上 able，就得到「能被念出来」的意思：嘴巴能顺利把它送出来。

normal.en: A word that can be said is pronounceable.
normal.cn: 能念出来的词就是 pronounceable。

normal.en: The -able suffix always signals that some action is possible.
normal.cn: able 词尾总是表示某种动作是可能的。

normal.en: Easily pronounceable names are easier to remember.
normal.cn: 容易念的名字更容易记住。

normal.en: Prolific writers also favour pronounceable titles.
normal.cn: 多产的作家也偏爱顺口易念的书名。

normal.en: Compare readable: readable is about eyes, pronounceable is about tongues.
normal.cn: 对比 readable：readable 讲眼睛，pronounceable 讲舌头。

abstract.en: See a mouth opening smoothly on each syllable.
abstract.cn: 想象一张嘴每个音节都顺畅地张开。

abstract.en: Picture a long word sliding down a smooth chute.
abstract.cn: 想象一个长单词顺着光滑的滑道溜下来。

abstract.en: Imagine a sealed note that cannot be read out loud.
abstract.cn: 想象一张被封住的纸条，念不出口。

examples.en: The new vaccine has an awkward but pronounceable name.
examples.cn: 这款新疫苗的名字有点拗口，但还念得出来。

examples.en: Short and pronounceable labels help tourists find their way.
examples.cn: 简短好念的标识能帮助游客认路。

examples.en: Some place names are hardly pronounceable outside the region.
examples.cn: 有些地名在本地区之外几乎没人念得出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普罗南斯额波」——pro 加 nounce 拼起来像一口气念完的音节，能这样念完的，就是可发音的；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前）＋ nuntiare（宣告）→ pronuntiare（宣布；说出）→ 古法语 prononcier → 英语 pronounce → 加 -able 构成 pronounceable，核心义「可以说出口」。

sensesIntro.en: Pronounceable begins as a matter of possibility, turns into a matter of ease in everyday speech, and keeps a formal shade of public declaration.
sensesIntro.cn: pronounceable 先表示「是否念得出来」，日常用法里再表示「是否顺口易念」，最后还保留了「是否适合公开说出」的正式意味。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open mouth letting syllables slip out smoothly.
core.cn: 核心意象：张开的嘴让音节顺畅地滑出来。

branches.en: Having the sound inventory needed is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 具备所需语音是基本义项。

branches.en: Ease of saying is the everyday extension.
branches.cn: 顺口容易念是日常延伸义项。

branches.en: Public declaration is the formal shade.
branches.cn: 公开宣布是正式色彩义项。

branches.en: Something can be sayable without being smooth to say.
branches.cn: 某事物能被念出来，不代表念起来就顺畅。

branches.en: Both involve how readily the tongue lets a word out.
branches.cn: 两者都涉及舌头把词放出来的难易程度。

intro.en: Pronounceable is a root verb plus the suffix -able, with the pro- prefix and the nounce root doing the main work.
intro.cn: pronounceable 由词根动词加 able 词尾构成，其中 pro- 前缀与 nounce 词根承担主要意义。

latinIntro.en: Latin pro- means forward, and nuntiare means to announce, so pronuntiare means to bring out in speech.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pro- 意为向前，nuntiare 意为宣告，因此 pronuntiare 意为「在言语中说出」。

items.example: The pro- prefix appears in proclaim and pronounce.
items.exampleCN: pro 前缀出现在 proclaim 与 pronounce 中。

items.example: Nuntiare supplies the announcing core.
items.exampleCN: nuntiare 提供「宣告」的核心意义。

items.example: Pronuntiare joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: pronuntiare 由前缀与词根拼成。

items.example: The nounce root appears in announce and denounce.
items.exampleCN: nounce 词根出现在 announce 与 denounce 中。

items.example: The verb pronounce comes from the French form.
items.exampleCN: 动词 pronounce 来自法语形式。

items.example: The suffix -able forms pronounceable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 able 构成 pronounceable。

items.example: The suffix -able forms readable and probable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 able 也构成 readable 与 probable。

items.example: The prefix un- forms unpronounceable.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 un 构成 unpronounceable。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms the adverb in a related word.
items.exampleCN: ly 词尾在其他相关词上构成副词。

definition_zh: 繁殖；增殖；传播；散布；使遗传；宣扬；鼓吹；（波、信号）传导
definition_en: to produce new plants or animals, or to spread ideas, traits, or waves outwards
core_image: 一根插枝被插进土里，长成一棵新的植株
scene: 园丁把月季的一段枝条插进湿土，几个月后这截枝条自己生根发芽，长成了一棵新苗。The gardener pushed a rose cutting into damp soil, and months later it began to propagate on its own into a new plant.
sceneCN: 这里 propagate 是「繁殖」（第 1 个义项：动植物通过插条、种子等方式产生新个体）；句意：园丁把一段月季插条插进湿土，几个月后它自己生根，繁殖成了一株新苗。

pos.zh: 传播；散布；宣扬；使遗传；传导

derivatives.zh: propagate 加 -ion 构成，义为「繁殖；传播」
propagate 加 -or 构成，义为「繁殖者；传播者；育苗器」
源自同一拉丁词根 propagare，义为「宣传；宣传品」，语义偏到政治领域
propagate 加 -ive 构成，书面语，义为「有繁殖力的；传播性的」

senses.title: To multiply as living things do
senses.definition: of plants, animals, or organisms, to produce new individuals and increase in number
senses.definitionCN: 指植物、动物或生物体产生新个体、数量增加
senses.example: Many houseplants propagate easily from stem cuttings.
senses.exampleCN: 很多室内植物用茎插条就能轻松繁殖。
senses.why: Latin propagare means to set a shoot into the ground so that it strikes root, which is exactly how the word starts life.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 propagare 意为“把嫩枝插进土里让它生根”，这个词最初的生命画面正是插枝成株。

senses.title: To spread ideas or information
senses.definition: to spread an idea, belief, practice, or piece of information widely
senses.definitionCN: 把观念、信仰、做法或消息广泛地散播开
senses.example: Social media can propagate false claims in hours.
senses.exampleCN: 社交媒体能在几小时内传播虚假说法。
senses.why: An idea behaves like a cutting: once planted in many minds, it roots and spreads without the original speaker.
senses.whyCN: 观念就像插条：一旦被种进许多人头脑里，它便自己生根扩散，不再需要当初那个说话的人。

senses.title: To hand down traits to offspring
senses.definition: to pass on genetic characteristics from parents to children
senses.definitionCN: 把遗传特征从亲代传给子代
senses.example: These genes propagate the disease through generations.
senses.exampleCN: 这些基因使疾病代代相传。
senses.why: The multiplying sense turns inward: each new individual carries a copy of the parent, so inheritance is propagation in a biological key.
senses.whyCN: 「增殖」的义素转向内部：每个新个体都复制了亲代，于是遗传就成了生物学意义上的传播。

senses.title: To travel through a medium
senses.definition: of waves, signals, or cracks, to move through a material medium
senses.definitionCN: 指波、信号或裂纹在介质中向前传递
senses.example: Light propagates through the glass fibre with little loss.
senses.exampleCN: 光在玻璃纤维中传播时损耗很小。
senses.why: Physical science borrows the spreading image for anything that moves outward from a source, including energy and even cracks.
senses.whyCN: 物理学借用了「向外散开」的画面，来形容一切从源头向外传递的东西，包括能量，甚至裂纹。

senses.title: To promote a cause openly
senses.definition: to spread and actively promote a belief, doctrine, or cause
senses.definitionCN: 主动散播并推动某种信仰、教义或事业
senses.example: Missionaries once propagated the faith along trade routes.
senses.exampleCN: 传教士曾沿贸易路线传播信仰。
senses.why: The spreading sense gains a missionary edge when an institution deliberately sends a message outward.
senses.whyCN: 当某个机构有意识地向外派出信息时，「传播」就染上了传教的色彩。

intro.en: Propagate comes from Latin propagare, derived from propago, a layer or shoot used to grow a new plant.
intro.cn: propagate 来自拉丁语 propagare，源于 propago（压条、插枝，用来长出新植株）。

items.en: Propago names a slip or layer taken to grow new vines.
items.cn: propago 指用来长出新藤的插枝或压条。

items.en: Propagare means to plant slips and make plants multiply.
items.cn: propagare 意为插条栽培，使植物增多。

items.en: English borrows propagate first for plant multiplication.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 propagate，最初指植物的增殖。

items.en: The sense extends to spreading doctrines and ideas.
items.cn: 词义扩展到传播教义与思想。

items.en: Modern science uses it for waves and signals.
items.cn: 现代科学用它来表示波与信号的传导。

note.en: Propagate shares the multi-journal family of spread words and looks like other pro- and -gate terms.
note.cn: propagate 属于「传播、增殖」语义家族，外形上又与若干以 pro 开头或以 gate 结尾的词相近。

entries.definition: the spreading or multiplying of something
information spread to influence opinion
wastefully extravagant
entries.definitionCN: 挥霍无度的；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to send out widely to many people
to spread information widely
to increase greatly in number

normalIntro.en: A propagation is a planting: pro- is forward and pago is a slip, so an idea can be set in soil too.
normalIntro.cn: 一次传播就是一次栽种：pro 是向前，pago 是插条，所以想法也能插进土里。

normal.en: A plant propagates by sending out new shoots.
normal.cn: 植物靠发出新枝条来繁殖。

normal.en: Rumours propagate faster than facts.
normal.cn: 谣言传播得比事实快。

normal.en: Propagation is the noun for any spreading.
normal.cn: propagation 是表「传播、繁殖」的名词。

normal.en: Radio waves propagate through air at the speed of light.
normal.cn: 无线电波以光速在空气中传播。

normal.en: Compare multiplication: multiply is about numbers, propagate about how the new ones grow.
normal.cn: 对比 multiply：multiply 讲数字增多，propagate 讲新个体怎么长出来。

abstract.en: Watch a cut stem push out its first root.
abstract.cn: 想象一截枝条冒出第一根须根。

abstract.en: See a rumour spreading like ripples across a pond.
abstract.cn: 想象谣言像池塘涟漪一样扩散。

abstract.en: Picture a parent handing a copy of the body to a child.
abstract.cn: 想象父母把自己的身体副本交给孩子。

examples.en: Strawberries propagate quickly by sending out runners.
examples.cn: 草莓靠长出走茎迅速繁殖。

examples.en: Disease-carrying insects helped propagate the infection across the region.
examples.cn: 带病的昆虫使感染在整个地区扩散。

examples.en: Sound propagates more slowly in water than in steel.
examples.cn: 声音在水中的传播比在钢中慢。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「破皮给特」——枝条破了皮插进土里，反而长得特别多，就是繁殖与传播；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 propago（插条、压条）→ propagare（插条栽培、使增多）→ 英语 propagate，核心义「从一截枝条生出一大片」。

sensesIntro.en: Propagate runs from planting cuttings, to spreading beliefs and information, to passing genes, to waves moving through a medium, and finally to promoting a cause.
sensesIntro.cn: propagate 从扦插繁殖出发，延伸到传播观念与信息，再指传递基因、波在介质中的传导，最后指宣扬某项事业。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a planting slip that roots by itself and becomes a new plant.
core.cn: 核心意象：一截插条自己生根，长成新的植株。

branches.en: Biological multiplication keeps the planting image intact.
branches.cn: 生物繁殖完整保留了栽种画面。

branches.en: Ideas are planted and then spread on their own.
branches.cn: 思想被种下，再自行扩散。

branches.en: Genes copy themselves into new individuals.
branches.cn: 基因自我复制进新个体。

branches.en: Physics keeps the outward-motion image for waves.
branches.cn: 物理学保留「向外运动」的画面来描述波。

branches.en: Both move a message outward with some purpose.
branches.cn: 两者都带着某种目的把信息向外推。

intro.en: Propagate is a Latin verb kept almost whole in English, with pro- and the slip-root pago inside it.
intro.cn: propagate 几乎是整词借入英语的拉丁语动词，内含 pro- 前缀与表示插条的 pago 词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin pro- means forward, and propago is a shoot set forward into the earth to root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pro- 意为向前，propago 指向前插进土里生根的枝条。

items.example: The pro- prefix appears in propagate and promote.
items.exampleCN: pro 前缀出现在 propagate 与 promote 中。

items.meaning: to fix, to set in place
items.example: The pago root gives the image of setting a slip.
items.exampleCN: pago 词根给出「插入枝条」的画面。

items.example: Propago is the cutting itself.
items.exampleCN: propago 就是插条本身。

items.example: Propagare is the direct source of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: propagare 是英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: The -ate ending marks many Latin verbs in English.
items.exampleCN: ate 词尾标记许多借入英语的拉丁动词。

items.example: The suffix -ion forms propagation.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 ion 构成 propagation。

items.example: The suffix -or forms propagator.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 or 构成 propagator。

items.example: The suffix -ive forms propagative.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 ive 构成 propagative。

items.example: Propaganda grew out of a committee name.
items.exampleCN: propaganda 源自一个委员会的名称。

definition_zh: 推进剂；火箭燃料；（气雾罐中的）压缩气体；推进的
definition_en: a gas or liquid substance that pushes something forward, especially rocket fuel or the compressed gas inside an aerosol can
core_image: 一束压缩气体从喷嘴喷出，把主体顶向前方
scene: 火箭立在发射塔旁，加注管正把冰冷的液体泵进燃料箱。The engineers loaded the liquid propellant into the tanks hours before the launch.
sceneCN: 这里 propellant 是「推进剂、火箭燃料」（第 2 个义项：火箭发动机所烧的燃料与氧化剂）；句意为工程师在发射前几个小时把液态推进剂装进燃料箱。

pos.zh: 名词：推进剂；火箭燃料；气雾罐中的压缩气体
形容词：推进的；用于推进的

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「推进；推动」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「推进；推进力」
由动词加表示施动者的后缀构成，义为「螺旋桨；推进器」

senses.title: A substance that drives something forward
senses.titleCN: 推进物质：产生推力的东西
senses.definition: a gas, liquid or solid whose burning or expansion creates forward force
senses.definitionCN: 燃烧或膨胀后产生向前推力的气体、液体或固体物质
senses.example: The compressed gas acts as a propellant in the spray can.
senses.exampleCN: 压缩气体在喷雾罐中起推进作用。
senses.why: The Latin verb propellere joins pro-, forward, to pellere, to drive; the -ant ending marks the thing that carries out that pushing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词 propellere 把 pro-（向前）接到 pellere（驱赶）上，-ant 后缀则标出「执行推动的那件东西」。

senses.title: Rocket fuel and oxidiser together
senses.definition: the fuel and oxidiser burned by a rocket engine to produce thrust, often stored as one package
senses.definitionCN: 火箭发动机燃烧以产生推力的燃料与氧化剂，常作为一个整体储存
senses.example: Solid propellant is easier to store than a liquid mixture.
senses.exampleCN: 固体推进剂比液体混合燃料更容易储存。
senses.why: In space the pushing substance must burn without air, so the word narrows to the complete fuel and oxidiser system.
senses.whyCN: 在太空中，推动物体的物质必须在没有空气时也能燃烧，于是这个词收窄为燃料与氧化剂的完整系统。

senses.title: The gas in an inhaler
senses.definition: a non-toxic gas that forces medicine out of an inhaler or nasal spray as a fine mist
senses.definitionCN: 把药物从吸入器或鼻喷剂中推出成细雾的无毒气体
senses.example: Many inhalers now use propellants that are gentler on the ozone layer.
senses.exampleCN: 如今许多吸入器使用的抛射剂对臭氧层更温和。
senses.why: The same pushing picture moves into medicine: the gas does not heal on its own, it only carries the drug into the lungs.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「推」的画面转入医学：气体本身不治病，只是把药送进肺里。

senses.title: The adjective use
senses.definition: describing a charge or device whose job is to drive something forward
senses.definitionCN: 描述以推动某物向前为职责的装药或装置
senses.example: A propellant charge was packed behind the shell.
senses.exampleCN: 一枚推进装药被塞在炮弹后方。
senses.why: English freely turns the noun into an attributive adjective, so a charge or a tank can simply be called propellant.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把名词直接用作定语，因此装药或储箱可直接称作「推进的」。

senses.title: The charge that fires a bullet
senses.definition: the smokeless powder that burns inside a gun barrel and drives a bullet or shell outward
senses.definitionCN: 在枪管内燃烧、把子弹或炮弹向外推出的无烟火药
senses.example: Experts say the propellant in old ammunition can become unstable.
senses.exampleCN: 专家说旧弹药里的发射药可能变得不稳定。
senses.why: Old firearms were also filled with a driving charge, and modern ballistics keeps the same Latin pushing root for that powder.
senses.whyCN: 旧式火器同样装填推进用药，现代弹道学为这种火药沿用了同一个拉丁语「推」词根。

intro.en: Propellant comes from Latin propellere, to drive forward, made of pro-, forward, and pellere, to drive. The English word was coined in the twentieth century for substances that push vehicles along.
intro.cn: propellant 来自拉丁语 propellere（向前驱赶），由 pro-（向前）与 pellere（驱赶）构成。英语里的这个词是二十世纪为「推动交通工具的物质」而造出的。

items.en: Pellere means to drive, push or beat, and propellere means to drive forward.
items.cn: pellere 意为驱赶、推、击打，propellere 意为向前驱赶。

items.en: The present participle propellens, driving forward, supplies the -ant shape later borrowed into English.
items.cn: 现在分词 propellens（向前推进的）为后来借入英语的 -ant 形式提供了模子。

items.en: The verb propel is borrowed from Latin and names the general act of pushing forward.
items.cn: 动词 propel 由拉丁语借入，泛指向前推动。

items.en: Propeller first names a device that moves a ship or aircraft, built with the agent suffix -er.
items.cn: propeller 起初指推动船舶或飞机的装置，带有施动者后缀 -er。

items.en: Propellant appears as the noun for rocket and spray-can substances after the development of rocketry.
items.cn: 随着火箭技术发展，propellant 作为名词出现，指火箭与喷雾罐所用的物质。

note.en: Propellant belongs to the Latin pellere family of driving words and to the small set of terms that describe how vehicles move.
note.cn: propellant 属于拉丁语 pellere「驱赶」词族，也与描述交通工具如何前进的一小组词相邻。

entries.definition: to push something forward
a revolving blade device that drives a ship or aircraft
entries.definitionCN: 推动船舶或飞机的旋转叶片装置

entries.definition: a substance that drives things away
entries.definitionCN: 把东西赶走的驱避剂；同根同后缀但方向相反

entries.definition: a material burned to release energy
entries.definitionCN: 燃烧以释放能量的燃料

entries.definition: the forward force produced by an engine
entries.definitionCN: 发动机产生的向前推力

entries.definition: a chemical supplying oxygen for burning
entries.definitionCN: 为燃烧提供氧的氧化剂

normalIntro.en: Propellant is built from the pellere family: pro- pushes forward, ex- pushes out, and re- pushes back.
normalIntro.cn: propellant 来自 pellere 词族：pro- 向前推，ex- 向外推，re- 向后推。

normal.en: Split it as propel plus -ant: the thing that does the propelling.
normal.cn: 拆成 propel 加 -ant：去做推进这件事的东西。

normal.en: Solid, liquid and hybrid are the three common types of rocket propellant.
normal.cn: 固体、液体与混合式是火箭推进剂常见的三种类型。

normal.en: A propellant tank is where the fuel waits before the engine fires.
normal.cn: propellant tank 就是发动机点火前燃料待着的储箱。

normal.en: Spray cans, inhalers and rockets all share the same propellant idea.
normal.cn: 喷雾罐、吸入器和火箭共享同一个推进剂概念。

normal.en: Remember the family chain pellere, propellere, propel, propellant as one driving line.
normal.cn: 把 pellere、propellere、propel、propellant 这条链当成一条「推」的线索来记。

abstract.en: Picture a rocket held up by nothing but a white jet of burning gas.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚火箭只靠一束白色燃烧气体托着升空。

abstract.en: Hear the hiss of a can as the hidden gas pushes the foam out.
abstract.cn: 听一听罐子喷出泡沫时那股被藏起来的气体的嘶声。

abstract.en: Think of a balloon let go, shooting around the room on its escaping air.
abstract.cn: 想象松手的气球靠着漏出的空气在房间里乱窜。

examples.en: The shuttle used liquid hydrogen and oxygen as propellants.
examples.cn: 航天飞机以液氢和液氧作为推进剂。

examples.en: Older aerosol cans contained a propellant that damaged the ozone layer.
examples.cn: 早期的气雾罐含有破坏臭氧层的推进剂。

examples.en: Safety inspectors check the propellant lines before every test.
examples.cn: 安全检验员在每次试验前检查推进剂管路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑若喷的」——往前一扑、若再一喷，火箭就被顶上天；这只是读音联想，与词源无关（真实词源见 propellere）。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ pellere（驱赶、推）→ propellere（向前推）→ 英语 propel（推进）→ propellant（推进剂）。同族的 expel（逐出）、repel（击退）保留了「推、赶」的核心。

sensesIntro.en: Propellant starts with the general idea of a pushing substance, then narrows to rocket fuel and spray gases, picks up an adjective use, and finally covers the powder in a gun.
sensesIntro.cn: propellant 先指泛指「起推动作用的东西」，再收窄为火箭燃料与喷雾气体，又衍生出形容词用法，最后还涵盖枪炮里的发射药。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a jet of releasing gas that shoves its own container forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：喷出的一束气体把自己的容器顶向前方。

branches.en: Any substance that creates forward force is the general sense.
branches.cn: 任何产生向前推力的物质都是泛指义项。

branches.en: Rocket engines need fuel and oxidiser together, the technical sense.
branches.cn: 火箭发动机需要燃料与氧化剂协同，这是技术义项。

branches.en: Inhalers borrow the same pushing gas idea for medicine.
branches.cn: 吸入器把同样的推动气体概念用于药物。

branches.en: Because the noun names a thing, it can stand before another noun as an adjective.
branches.cn: 因为名词指物，它可以放在另一个名词前作定语。

branches.en: Rocket fuel and gun powder are both burned charges that push a load away.
branches.cn: 火箭燃料与枪用火药都是燃烧后把载荷推出去的装药。

intro.en: Propellant is assembled from the Latin verb pellere and the prefix pro-, with the suffix -ant turning the action into a substance.
intro.cn: propellant 由拉丁语动词 pellere 与前缀 pro- 组装，再由后缀 -ant 把动作变成一种物质。

latinIntro.en: Latin pro- means forward, pellere means to drive, and propellere means to drive forward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pro- 意为向前，pellere 意为驱赶，propellere 意为向前驱赶。

items.example: Pellere is the driving root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: pellere 是整个词族的「驱赶」根源。

items.example: The prefix pro- points the push forward.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 pro- 把推的方向指向前方。

items.example: Propellere is the direct source of propel.
items.exampleCN: propellere 是 propel 的直接来源。

items.example: Propel is the plain English verb.
items.exampleCN: propel 是朴素的英语动词。

items.meaning: a thing that performs an action
items.example: The suffix -ant turns propel into a substance.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ant 把 propel 变成一种物质。

items.example: The suffix -er forms propeller from propel.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 由 propel 构成 propeller。

items.example: Propulsion names the process rather than the substance.
items.exampleCN: propulsion 指过程而非物质。

items.example: Expel means driving something outward.
items.exampleCN: expel 表示把东西向外赶。

items.example: Repel means driving something back.
items.exampleCN: repel 表示把东西向后赶。
